label: target-final-inventory
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=<WORKDIR>/E4/known_hosts -o GlobalKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -i <WORKDIR>/E4/id_ed25519 -p 22145 root@127.0.0.1 bash -s
script:
set -ux
hostname
cat /etc/machine-id
cat /sys/class/dmi/id/product_uuid
ip -br link
sha256sum /root/e4/declaration.json
sqlite3 '/srv/e4/browser/Default/Cookies' 'SELECT host_key,name,length(value),length(encrypted_value),hex(substr(encrypted_value,1,3)) FROM cookies;'
find /root/.config/chromium -maxdepth 4 -type f -printf '%p %s bytes\n'
pgrep -a chromium || true
ls -l /dev/tpm* 2>/dev/null || true
journalctl -u NetworkManager -u postgresql@15-main -u e4-sshd -u e4-secret-consumer --no-pager > /root/e4/services.log
systemctl is-active postgresql@15-main redis-server
